criteria.statement: The e2e-agent harness identifies Bahia's real MCP command/connection contract as HTTP JSON-RPC at /mcp or /api/v1/mcp, not a stdio placeholder.
The smoke path attempts MCP tool discovery against the configured Bahia MCP endpoint and does not encode placeholder skip behavior.
Invalid non-HTTP MCP placeholder configuration fails closed with an explicit configuration error.
Docker-unavailable environments still fail at the Docker preflight before stack execution when the harness manages docker-compose.
